slides.title: Filter coffee is not a long espresso
slides.subtitle: More water doesn't turn one into the other. The method does.

slides.myth: Filter coffee is just an espresso with more water.
slides.truth: The amount of water isn't the difference. The method is. Espresso is pushed through the coffee under pressure. Filter coffee drips through by gravity alone.

slides.title: A lungo is still espresso
slides.body: Lungo means "long" in Italian. It gets more water, but that water is still pushed through fine coffee under pressure. Filter coffee skips the pressure, and a paper filter holds back some of the coffee's oils.
slides.highlight: More water doesn't change the method.

slides.label: The tip
slides.body: Want a filter-style cup at home? Running your espresso longer won't get you there. You need a filter and a coarser grind.

slides.title: Different method, not just more water
slides.body: Espresso: pressure and a fine grind. Filter: gravity and a coarser grind.
